artworks.title: The Little Hat
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a person in profile. The person is wearing a wide-brimmed hat with decorations, and a high-collared garment. The etching is sparse, with minimal details on clothing and background. The background features diagonal and vertical lines for texture.

artworks.title: The Mantle
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a sketch style. The person is facing slightly left, with their head turned towards the viewer. They wear a wide-brimmed hat and a cloak/shawl covering their upper body. The lower body is wearing a long skirt. The background is plain and textured.

artworks.title: Gipsy Baby
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: In the image, a sketch shows parts of two figures. The body of the seated figure, likely a child, is almost fully visible and positioned facing the viewer while sitting. The child's facial features include large eyes, and their hair is curly, framing their face. The second figure appears behind the child, cropping at the chest, and is angled slightly to the side. This figure seems to be wearing a wide-brimmed hat, which partially obscures their face, making specific features indistinct. Both figures are drawn with loose, expressive lines that suggest clothing comprising flowing garments or dresses. The illustration is devoid of elaborate details or color, using simple line work set against a plain background of aged paper.

artworks.title: Little Nude Figure
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This print shows a full-body sketch of a woman standing in a relaxed position, facing slightly to the right. The woman's head and face are indistinct, indicated only by small areas of cross-hatching. She may have short, close-cropped hair, but her hair may also simply blend into the shading of the background. The woman is nude, with her body turned mostly to the right. Her torso, legs, and arms are visible, although her hands are indistinct. The background is beige paper partially filled with diagonal crosshatching lines.

artworks.title: Cameo, No.I
artworks.medium: etching on Asian wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a woman depicted from the side in a crouched or seated position, facing toward the right side of the image. Her entire body is shown although she is bent over, placing her head close to a small animal, possibly a dog, that she is interacting with. Her hair appears to be styled in a bun at the back of her head, with some hair covering part of her face, and there seems to be a ribbon or band securing the hair. She is wearing a long, flowing dress that envelops her body and drapes onto the floor. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects held in her hands besides the interaction with the animal. The background is plain and consists of a simple paper texture, focusing all attention on the sketched figures with no additional elements or scenery to consider.

artworks.title: Canal, Ostend
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a wide, flat landscape with a calm and expansive setting. The horizon is above the center, showcasing distant houses and small figures. Sketchy clouds and fine linework in black ink on sepia-toned paper create a sketch-like quality. Sparse details of grass and landscape are present in the foreground.

artworks.title: Church, Brussels
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with furniture and architectural details. The drawing depicts a room with columns, a large chandelier or a decorative element on the ceiling, and various pieces of furniture distributed around the space. On the right side of the drawing, there is a circular feature. The lines are sketchy and expressive, suggesting the outlines and forms of these interior elements without providing detailed representation. The atmosphere appears calm and serene. The presence of both architectural and furnishing elements provides a sense of depth within the space, while the minimal detailing leaves much to the viewer's imagination.

artworks.title: High Street, Brussels
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene with a building's facade. There are figures outside the building, some seemingly engaged in different activities. A large wheel is visible in the foreground, suggesting the presence of a cart or vehicle. The lines are sketchy, creating a dynamic and lively atmosphere. Light and shadow are used to emphasize the building's features and the figures in the scene.

artworks.title: Gold-House, Brussels
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (trimmed to plate): 17.9 x 6.6 cm (7 1/16 x 2 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a front-facing view of an ornate building captured from a low angle. The structure features detailed architectural elements, including windows, embellishments, and a possible decorative clock. The style is characterized by sketch-like brushstrokes, with fine, controlled lines. The color palette is monochrome with light beige and dark lines. Indistinct figures appear near the building, and there are light indications of cloud formations in the sky. The etching depicts a sense of historical or architectural significance.

artworks.title: Palaces, Brussels
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate building featuring a grand, multi-story facade with intricate carvings, statues, and decorative windows. The drawing also includes rough sketches of market stalls in front of the building, suggesting a bustling street scene. The lower section of the image includes a note or handwritten text related to the drawing.

artworks.title: Grand' Place, Brussels
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (trimmed to plate): 21.8 x 14 cm (8 9/16 x 5 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a frontal view of an elaborate building. The building fills most of the composition, with a structured facade, detailed entrance, and windows. The upper section of the building displays intricate carvings and decorative statues. The artwork appears in a linear style with precise strokes, resembling etching. The color scheme is monochromatic, composed of varying shades of brown. In the foreground, there are figures in an open space, potentially a public square. In the distance, the detailed architecture stands out against the background.

artworks.title: Courtyard, Rue P.L. Courier
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a detailed linear drawing of a stone wall with rustic architectural elements. The drawing is viewed from a direct point of view, emphasizing tall windows and a doorway. The intricate style of the etching includes delicate hash-like brushstrokes defining textures. Clothes hang above, lightly drawn. The scene is depicted in a monochrome palette with subtle contrasts. The street is visible close by with sketch-like, winding patterns.

artworks.title: Railway Station, Voves
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape from a slightly elevated view, showcasing a rural scene with a horizon line in the middle. The horizon features silhouettes of trees, buildings, and a windmill on the left side. The sketch uses fine lines and minimal ink, creating a sketch-like appearance with open spaces. In the foreground on the left, there is a simple cart with a horse and figures nearby. The color scheme is primarily beige and sepia, with dark brown or black ink. The overall style is minimalistic with an emphasis on line work and limited detail.

artworks.title: Little Market Place, Tours
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on chine collé on  Asian wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene with buildings and market stalls. The drawing shows a bustling street lined with stalls on both sides, covered by awnings, and displaying various goods. In the center, there's an archway of a large building labeled as "HÔTEL" leading into a courtyard or passage. The street is busy, filled with human forms interacting around the stalls and under the awnings. A small dog is depicted in the foreground, wandering down the street. The background features more buildings, some of which are multi-storied, with windows and chimneys. The drawing is rendered in fine lines, creating a sketch-like appearance with an emphasis on the bustling atmosphere and architectural details.

artworks.title: Hangman's House, Tours
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an arched doorway with ornate details. The drawing showcases the detailed linework forming the decorative arch and the surrounding stone structure. The doorway has rich ornamental carvings with swirling patterns above it. Below the arch, two indistinct forms are sketched, suggesting inanimate objects placed in front of the door. The artist has used fine lines to create texture and depth, capturing the intricate architectural elements. The scene conveys an old-world charm, indicative of classic architectural designs.

artworks.title: Mairie, Loches
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 21.6 × 12.9 cm (8 1/2 × 5 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a tall building. The horizon is not visible. The artwork uses fine lines to depict architectural details and figures. A limited color palette is used, mainly in natural tones and dark ink. There are figures near us, with some engaged and leading a child. Another figure sits further to the right. In the distance, the entrance of a building and more faintly depicted figures can be seen. The building has ornate windows and a decorative facade, taking up much of the vertical space.

artworks.title: Chancellerie, Loches
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a street scene with tall buildings on both sides of a narrow street. The viewpoint is slightly elevated. The buildings are detailed with an etching style using fine lines. The scene is in a monochrome sepia palette, giving it a vintage look. People are depicted engaging in various activities on the street. The composition creates a sense of depth with the buildings gradually receding in the distance. The focus is on the street and architecture, with minimal details in the sky.

artworks.title: Hotel de Ville, Loches
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brown on "old Dutch" laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an etching of a busy street scene from an elevated viewpoint. A tall building with a clock is prominent at the top, with detailed architecture. The etching uses delicate lines for a sense of movement and depth. The color scheme is mainly brown and sepia tones. Figures in the street are engaged in different activities, creating a lively atmosphere. Additional buildings line the street, leading the eye into the distance.

artworks.title: Poultry-Market, Loches
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 7.8 × 14.7 cm (3 1/16 × 5 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch depicting multiple figures in an outdoor setting. The figures are shown mostly from head to toe, standing or sitting in various positions. Their facial features are not distinctly defined due to the rough sketch. The figures are wearing long, flowing garments typical of historical or classical attire. Some are shown in poses suggesting conversation or interaction, while others are passive or seated. There are no distinct items of jewelry or prominent objects visible in the sketch. The background is minimal and abstract, with simple lines hinting at structural elements or additional figures, creating atmosphere without specific details.

artworks.title: Tour St. Antoine, Loches
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 14.7 × 7.9 cm (5 13/16 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of an urban street scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The street leads towards a tower in the distance, with buildings lining either side. The tower is under construction and the sketch is done in sepia tones with dark ink, highlighting the line work. Figures are shown in motion on the street, contributing to the sense of activity in the scene.

artworks.title: Clock-Tower, Amboise
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street view with a clock tower in the distance. The scene features buildings, rooftops receding into the distance, and a few figures on the street. The etching has delicate lines and a monochromatic sepia color palette, giving a vintage feel.

artworks.title: Hotel Lallement, Bourges
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene outside a building with architectural elements, figures, and chickens. The view is from a slight distance and at eye level. The lines are fine and linear, typical of an etching technique. The color palette is neutral, with ink on paper giving it an earthy, monochromatic appearance accentuating light and shadow. There is a woman holding a child, a small child near a bench, and an ornate building with decorative details to the right.

artworks.title: Windows Opposite Hotel, Bourges
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 9.8 × 6.6 cm (3 7/8 × 2 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of a facade of an architectural structure, focusing on detailed sketches of two windows set within a textured brick wall. The horizon is not visible. The illustration is rendered with fine, linear, and cross-hatched strokes, highlighting architectural features like sills and archways. The color palette is monochromatic with a sepia tone. The art style suggests a preliminary study of the building's detail with a soft focus on sections.

artworks.title: The Steps, Amsterdam
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on Asian tissue, mounted on off-white paperboard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a waterfront house. The drawing shows an architectural scene with a house by a canal edge, with reflections in the water. The house has various textures like old masonry and hanging fabrics. Stairs lead up to a platform near the entryway. The drawing has intricate details with fine linework to depict reflections and patterns.
